title: Engine diet: port controlnet_aux's 3 preprocessors into MpiNodes
description: We use AIO_Preprocessor, DepthAnythingV2Preprocessor and OpenposePreprocessor (Krea2, Qwen Edit, Qwen Image 2.1, SDXL/Illustrious/Pony, Chroma, Klein). The pack is ~99k lines with 25 pip requirements (mediapipe, onnxruntime-gpu, trimesh, albumentations, fvcore, scikit-learn...). Find which annotators AIO actually resolves to, port only those, drop the pack. Biggest single dependency win. Part of the Engine diet umbrella.
